issues.title: Recursive Status compares a ContextSnapshotRef occurrence UID to the live target UID
issues.expected: `status --recursive` on `task-2/participant` follows its retained Context snapshot using the snapshot's target Context identity and renders a read-only frame.
issues.actual: Status exited 1 with `An embedded Context identity changed during Status.` Host diagnosis shows occurrence UID c458ab18 differs from the live target UID b839b146, while the snapshot's explicit target_context_uid correctly equals b839b146.
issues.workaround: Use `status --short`, default direct Status, or an exact direct read that does not follow embedded snapshot occurrences.
issues.reproduction: 1/1 recursive Status on the snapshot-bearing task-2/participant Context

issues.title: Cumulative ticker identity collisions invalidated the Admin import/Rename fixture
issues.expected: Admin Context import M1/M2 creates fresh by-value scratch fixtures that positive-control Rename M1/M2 can rename without touching Branch/Checkout targets.
issues.actual: The cumulative ticker Profile already contained the task-1 Context stable UIDs, so both imports rejected aliasing the same identities and both dependent Renames found no Source. Branch3 consequently succeeded; the harness stopped before unsafe Checkout3 cloning and continued with an explicit clean-O target-collision route and exact Branch3 Undo/Redo.
issues.workaround: Preflight imported stable identities host-side and choose a source Context whose UID is absent from the active cumulative Profile, or reserve init-created scratch fixtures for all positive Renames.
issues.reproduction: 2/2 Context imports and their 2/2 dependent positive Renames

issues.title: Admin protocol incorrectly expected default Init to reject a missing lexical parent
issues.expected: The campaign protocol expected `init C/missing-parent/leaf` without `--parents` to fail.
issues.actual: Init correctly created only the exact leaf Context and switched to it; no parent Context object exists. The current operation contract reserves parent-Context creation for `--parents`.
issues.workaround: Use a collision, invalid UID-shaped name, or another documented validation failure for a negative Init method; treat a missing lexical parent as a valid exact-leaf route.
issues.reproduction: 1/1 default exact-leaf Init with an absent parent Context

interleave_exception.rationale: The ADMIN protocol requires round 1 last `mem switch --previous`, then round 2 first `mem switch --next` with no intervening mem call so the navigation transaction itself is preserved.
